jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Program Manager, Incubation Data Center (m/f/d), you will play a key role in driving innovation within the Data Center Business Unit at Danfoss Power Solutions, preferably based in Copenhagen, Denmark. You'll lead local and global cross-functional project teams from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, control and closure, ensuring successful delivery of the agreed business case. You'll take ownership of low- to medium-risk programs across new product development (NPD), product-related initiatives, large-scale new business onboarding and cost-out/value analysis and value engineering (VA/VE) projects.

Your impact will be measured by successful project delivery, transparent reporting to leadership and timely corrective action. You'll also help develop and continuously improve processes, guidelines and tools for new product development, bringing teams together and driving accountability in a matrix organization.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Plan and lead medium-complexity programs: build program management plans, cross-functionally informed work breakdown structures (WBS) and schedules; align priorities, staffing, requirements and a robust Statement of Work (SoW) before baseline; ensure the team understands contractual commitments and baseline change control.

• Drive disciplined execution and delivery: manage scope and scope changes, run regular team meetings, follow through on commitments and action items, and assess program health through earned-value measures (CPI/SPI), quality, technical performance, Focus 5 and delivery indicators. Identify and quantify risks and opportunities, implement mitigation plans and initiate corrective actions when needed.

• Own the business case and customer outcomes: understand the strategic product roadmap and how the organization develops and launches products; validate customer needs and pain points with relevant stakeholders, account for product and development requirements, and ensure program scope and execution support successful Entry-Into-Service (EIS). Assess changes against business-case impact and guide team decisions accordingly.

• Lead through collaboration and communication: build relationships with cross-functional leaders and key customers, communicate progress and issues promptly and transparently to internal and external leadership, and influence international or cross-divisional teams without relying on formal authority. Inspire accountability, recognize strengths and development needs, and mentor and coach team members.

• Improve how change is delivered: develop and refine NPD processes and tools, apply organizational change-management principles, and coordinate communication, training, feedback and mitigation. Monitor change effectiveness, navigate cultural diversity and organizational dynamics, and adapt plans and resources to address obstacles.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Master’s degree in Business or a technical field (required).

• At least five years of project management or engineering experience (required); Program Management Professional certification is preferred.

• Strong command of project and program management methods and tools, with consistent follow-up, structured planning, performance monitoring, risk management and timely corrective action.

• Ability to independently lead cross-divisional and international teams in a matrix environment, build strong networks, empower colleagues through delegation and create commitment through open, constructive dialogue.

• Sound judgment in complex situations: anticipate and overcome roadblocks, evaluate alternative solutions, communicate appropriately across stakeholders and adapt effectively to organizational change and cultural differences.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

As a Specialist, Digital Engagement, you will play a key role in bringing Pandora’s global campaigns to life across digital touchpoints. You will plan, develop, and execute content across web and email, ensuring engaging and high-performing consumer journeys that align with both brand storytelling and commercial priorities.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will support campaigns end-to-end - from briefing through to execution - ensuring consistency, quality, and continuous optimisation across channels and markets. You will also contribute to refining customer journeys by leveraging insights, performance data, and user behaviour.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute digital campaigns across web and email in line with global brand and commercial strategies

• Translate campaign concepts into engaging, high-performing digital experiences

• Coordinate content across channels and ensure consistency across markets

• Support end-to-end campaign delivery, from briefing to implementation

• Analyse performance data and apply insights to optimise campaigns and customer journeys

• Contribute to continuous improvement of content, placements, and user experience

• Provide guidance and support on local campaign execution

**Your impact

**You will directly influence the quality and effectiveness of Pandora’s digital campaigns and customer journeys across owned channels. Through strong execution and continuous optimisation, you will drive improved engagement, conversion, and brand consistency, while strengthening e-commerce and email performance and enhancing the overall digital customer experience.

**What You’ll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you bring a solid foundation of experience, strong practical skills, and a proactive, hands-on mindset:

**Experience

**

• Approx. 3+ years of experience in digital campaigns, e-commerce, email, or content management

• Experience working within digital marketing, ideally across web and email environments

• Track record of executing digital campaigns and projects

**Skills

**

• Hands-on experience delivering digital-first campaigns in an e-commerce and email

• setup

• Strong understanding of customer journeys and cross-channel execution

• Experience creating engaging digital shopping experiences

• Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into optimisation actions

• Ability to analyse performance data and improve marketing and business KPIs

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience from a global organisation is a plus

**Tools

**

• Proficiency in tools such as Excel, Jira, Figma, and PowerPoint

**Key stakeholders

**You will collaborate closely with a broad range of teams across the business to bring campaigns to life end-to-end. This includes colleagues working with brand and creative development, media and marketing activation, retail, and customer engagement (including email and loyalty).

You will also partner with digital and technology teams focused on product, user experience, and engineering, as well as commercial and e-commerce teams across global and regional markets.

In addition, you will work with external partners such as creative and digital agencies, as well as technology and platform providers.

**Ways of working

**You will operate in a fast-paced, agile environment, balancing execution and optimisation while managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders. The role offers a high degree of ownership, with clear objectives and guidance within established frameworks.

**Additional Information

**Global Career Band: 5B

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Are you passionate about turning employee insights into workplace experiences that truly make a difference? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

As our new Senior Workspace Experience Specialist, you'll drive employee experience, workplace engagement and change initiatives across global locations, shaping how Grundfos employees work, collaborate and thrive.

**What You Will Be Doing

**As part of the Global People & Workspace team, you'll translate workplace data and employee feedback into improvements that enhance the everyday experience for colleagues across our global sites.

Your main responsibilities include:

• Drive employee experience and workplace engagement initiatives globally, using workplace data and employee feedback to identify improvement opportunities

• Lead communication, stakeholder engagement and change management supporting workplace transformations

• Facilitate workshops and stakeholder discussions to align workplace solutions with business needs

• Support the development and implementation of global workspace concepts, standards and employee experience initiatives

• Develop strategic recommendations and business cases based on workplace insights and business needs

• Lead workplace projects with HR, Group Facility, business stakeholders and external partners, ensuring delivery within scope, quality, timeline and budget

**What Makes You a Great Fit

**Above all, you're a collaborative and outgoing professional who can turn employee insights into practical workplace solutions. You bring facilitation and stakeholder management skills and experience driving change in international, matrix-based organisations. We'd also imagine that you are/have:

• 5+ years of relevant experience in employee experience, workplace strategy, change management, service design or similar disciplines

• Proven ability to support cross-functional projects and translate employee insights into practical solutions

• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and communication skills in international, matrix-based environments

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

**It's a plus if you also:

**

• Hold a Master's or Bachelor's degree in Employee Experience, Workplace Strategy, Service Design, Change Management, UX, People & Culture or a related field

• Have experience supporting organisational change and adoption at a global scale

• Have strong PowerPoint, Word and Excel skills for developing business cases and recommendations

You'll also be available to travel up to 20 days per year.

Why you'll love working here

Day to day, you can look forward to:

• A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.

• Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.

• On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

Join Grundfos, apply today!

jobs.occupation: Manager for the Drug Product Development and Analysis Team
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where you can explore scientific challenges and have a significant impact? Are you passionate about developing life-saving vaccines, and enjoy close collaboration and leading a small development team?

We are expanding and looking for a new Manager to support our development projects!

**Join our team and let us make a difference together

**Our Process Development department in Hørsholm develops and optimizes vaccine production processes and supports our production sites. The Department handles diverse and evolving tasks and includes 32 members across 4 specialized teams.

We are looking for a manager to head our Drug Product Development and Analysis Team, consisting of three Scientists and three Technicians reporting to the Head of Process Development. The team focuses on drug product process and formulation development, stability studies, and analyzing development samples for ongoing programs.

Apart from managing the team an important part of the role will be hands-on to review analytical results, maintain the analytical methods and drive the execution of the analytical tasks in the team.

“We look forward to welcoming you to a dedicated and engaged department, where we value good team spirit and an easy-going, humorous environment,” says Janus Falhof, Head of Process Development.

**Your Impact

**You must have a strong interest in consistently delivering high-quality analytical data and to support the department’s development studies. Given the function of the team, there will be close interaction with all the teams in the department.

Your tasks will include:

• Driving the daily operation of the team, setting the scientific direction, and ensuring the development of the team members

• Ensuring established analysis assays run smoothly and deliver high-quality data on time, while supporting the team in developing new assays to advance the department

• Communicating daily with the team and collaborating closely with Production, Quality Control, and R&D

**Are You Our Next Pioneer?

**To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

• M.S. in Biotechnology, Human Biology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, preferably with a PhD in protein chemistry or a related topic

• 3-5 years of relevant experience from the biotech industry or academia Previous experience with pharmaceutical analyses, e.g. chromatographic methods, particle methods and protein methods

• Previous experience with formulation development, statistical data analysis, and an understanding of protein chemistry

• Fluency in spoken and written English is required

**Who Are You?

**You are self-driven, responsible, and approach scientific challenges with curiosity and innovation. Success relies on strong teamwork, people skills, and the ability to engage in cross-functional dialogue. A proactive, calm, and positive attitude, combined with adaptability to new priorities, is beneficial. Good teamwork abilities are essential in a diverse, international department.

**Why join us?

**

• Be part of a team that directly contributes to global health by manufacturing and developing life-saving vaccines

• Your work here has a visible and significant impact, ensuring the safety and well-being of millions

• Join the fascinating field of vaccine production, where every day brings new challenges and opportunities to protect public health

• Enjoy a vibrant staff club that offers a variety of diverse, fun, and exciting events

**Are you ready to join us in our mission?

**If this sounds like the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

We look forward to receiving your application together with your CV. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Job responsibilities

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Technology & Innovation - Control & Connectivity Solutions
jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Senior Manager, Technology & Innovation, you will shape the future of control systems used in off-road mobile machinery around the world. Leading a team of Architects and Innovation Engineers, you will define and drive the technology roadmap for next-generation Controllers, Displays, Remote Controls, and Joysticks, helping create the technologies that will power safer, more productive, connected, and increasingly autonomous machines.

This role combines people leadership, technology strategy, system architecture, and innovation. Working across our global Engineering and Portfolio organizations, you will turn customer needs, market trends, regulatory requirements, and emerging technologies into scalable platform solutions that enable future product development. You'll have the opportunity to influence key technology decisions, develop talented teams, and help bring new technologies from early exploration into real-world customer value.

The position is ideally based at one of our Danfoss Power Solutions locations in Northern Europe, with flexibility for other locations where local employment regulations allow.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Define and drive the technology and innovation roadmap for our Control & Connectivity Solutions portfolio, ensuring it supports future product and platform strategies.

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Architects and Innovation Engineers, creating an environment built on collaboration, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

• Own and govern key architecture principles and technology choices for future generations of Controllers, Displays, Remote Controls, and Joysticks.

• Build and manage a technology pipeline that moves ideas from exploration and proof-of-concept through technology maturation and handover into product development.

• Translate customer, market, regulatory, and technology trends into engineering opportunities, working closely with Portfolio Management, Product Management, Engineering, and Procurement teams across the global organization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience leading and developing technical teams within engineering, technology, innovation, or product development environments.

• Great experience developing embedded and connected mechatronic systems that integrate electronics, embedded software, communication technologies, and mechanical design.

• Expertise in defining technology strategies, system architectures, technology roadmaps, or product platforms for complex products and systems.

• Understanding of functional safety, machinery regulations, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance within embedded industrial, automotive, mobile machinery, or similarly regulated environments.

• Ability to collaborate, influence decisions, and build effective relationships across global, cross-functional organizations.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• You'll lead a highly skilled technical team and influence the technologies and architectures behind future generations of machine control solutions.

• You'll work closely with senior leaders across Engineering and Portfolio Management, giving you visibility and impact on key technology and product decisions.

• You'll gain exposure to emerging technologies and help turn new ideas into scalable solutions used by customers around the world.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities. You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about, we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited by the opportunity to shape technology strategy, lead talented engineers, and help create the next generation of intelligent machine control solutions, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role and Department

**Our QC lab is growing in activities and looking to recruit an IT System Administrator to join our team onsite in Ballerup.

As IT system administrator at Genmab, you will provide administrative and developmental support to all our QC IT systems in our Quality Control Laboratory.

The laboratory is responsible for supporting Genmab’s innovative products by performing release and stability testing according to ICH guidelines. Systems are mainly the Labvantage Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), but also the Empower Chromatography software and additional software controlling analytical equipment.

The role requires a detailed understanding of the LIMS and Empower systems used by QC and its maintenance requirements. The IT system administrator will own the system validation packages, the SOPs, and associated training packages.

The position requires compliance with regulatory requirements to cGMP. Unique to this position is the chance to define the way we work with laboratory IT systems at Genmab.

You will be joining a small team of ambitious and professional colleagues within related fields, who can help you settle into your role, and keep the spirit high while performing the important tasks for our laboratory. The laboratory is newly established, so expect a pioneering atmosphere, where you will help adjust the ways of working in an efficiency oriented direction. We expect you to be ambitious, motivated, self-driven, and to be able to make your colleagues shine in an environment of respectful and flexible collaboration.

You will report to the Associate Director of QC Support, Laboratory systems and Equipment.

**Responsibilities

**

• Liaison between System Users, Application Managers (IT) & QA.

• Drives Business related aspects of system application operations, design, testing, and improvements.

• Manage user access administration and providing initial and on-going training for users.

• Responsible for practical aspects of maintaining the validated state of GxP systems.

• Ensure data integrity and compliance with company SOPs, requirement specifications, and cGMP regulations.

• Load and configure method templates in LIMS and Empower.

• Perform all aspects of QMS processes – Change Control, Deviations, CAPAs – for software used in QC lab.

• Report achievements and escalate issues.

**Requirements

**

• It is expected that you have at least 5 years of documented professional experience working according to GMP in a QC setting

• You have a thorough understanding of the detailed requirements for Software Validation and are up to date with current trends

• Experience with qualification of analytical instruments is desirable as you will be the owner of the validation and qualification activities

• Experience in leading projects and driving cross-functional initiatives/stakeholders

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK597.312,00---895.968,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Senior Data Engineer

• Full-time

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and AI? Do you have extensive experience in data engineering and want to help shape the future of a fast-growing, international retail company? Then this could be your next career opportunity!

At JYSK, we recognize the importance of data and AI in maintaining our position as a leading retailer. We see a huge potential in leveraging technology to enhance customer experiences, increase sales, and boost profitability - ultimately making life better for our customers and employees.

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our AI Engineering team. You will become part of a passionate team of specialists working at the forefront of data and AI, building the data foundations and scalable solutions that enable us to turn business opportunities into tangible AI solutions.

If you’re excited about driving innovation and creating real business impact through data and AI in an international retail environment, we want to hear from you!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of data at JYSK and play a key role in accelerating AI adoption across the organization. As part of our high-performing, agile AI Engineering team, you’ll have significant influence on technology choices, architectural decisions, and data engineering best practices. You’ll also take ownership of building and maintaining the scalable, reliable data infrastructure that powers our AI initiatives and enables new business opportunities.

If you’re passionate about technical innovation, enjoy solving complex business challenges through data, and want to make a tangible impact in an international retail organization, we’d love to hear from you!

Furthermore, we offer you:

• 
A dynamic workplace in an international company focused on growth, innovation, and continuous development.

• 
A collaborative, open-minded environment with opportunities to engage across all organisational levels.

• 
A flexible work-from-home policy that supports a healthy work-life balance.

• 
Attractive employee benefits, including staff discounts across the Lars Larsen Group and a variety of social events throughout the year.

• 
Access to internal training, courses, and learning opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.

• 
A welcoming and supportive culture, complemented by a comprehensive onboarding programme to help you succeed from day one.

• 
A low-politics, low-ego culture where collaboration, ownership, and high standards are valued.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a key role in building data solutions that drive innovation, enable data-driven decision-making, optimize business operations, and enhance customer experiences. Leveraging your strong software engineering background, you will design, build, and optimize complex, scalable data products that provide the foundation for integrated AI solutions and deliver tangible business value.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• 
Design, implement, deploy, and maintain scalable data products across the entire data lifecycle, from data ingestion and transformation to analytics, visualization, and dashboarding.

• 
Design and implement scalable data transformations that integrate seamlessly with existing systems and applications.

• 
Build data products capable of processing structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data to support diverse AI workloads.

• 
Design and implement automated data quality monitoring, validation, and alerting to ensure trusted data products.

• 
Promote and drive adoption of modern data engineering technologies and automation frameworks.

• 
Help ensure data governance, quality, security, privacy, and compliance across AI-related data products.

• 
Maintain metadata, lineage, and documentation to improve data discoverability and governance.

• 
Collaborate closely with AI Solution Architect, AI Platform Engineers and AI Engineers to develop and enhance the data components of our MLOps and AI platform.

• 
Managing and optimizing data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to ensure scalability, reliability, performance, and efficient resource utilization.

• 
Working with architects to refine data solution design and contributing to solution planning phases.

• 
Supporting end-users of AI solutions with a "you build it, you own it" mindset.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• 
Holds a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field.

• 
Has 5+ years of industry experience in data engineering, with a strong track record in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and robust data architectures.

• 
Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable, reliable, and efficient DataOps solutions, preferably using tools such as dbt or Dataform.

• 
Has experience developing, deploying, operating, and monitoring data solutions in production at scale, preferably on Google Cloud Platform (or equivalent experience with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work with GCP).

• 
Works independently on complex technical challenges while collaborating effectively with stakeholders to ensure successful outcomes.

• 
Embraces an MVP mindset and enjoy rapidly delivering, validating, and iterating on data solutions within an agile team.

• 
Is proactive, enjoys sharing knowledge and mentoring colleagues, and takes pride in delivering high-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader AI Engineering, Florencio Paucar at +45 27794325.

Send us a brief application with your CV by clicking “Apply”. We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

ABOUT US

We believe that our employees are key to our success going from one store in 1979 to more than 3,400 stores worldwide today. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing within JYSK, and we also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in delegation and freedom with responsibility.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

Looking for a workplace where you can make real change? A meaningful job where you have the freedom, trust and responsibilities to play an important role and not just be a small fish in a big shoal? Does being a part of a social, passionate, and international team sound right to you? Join us!

Your position

In your new position as a Telecom & Network Engineer in the Telecom Engineering Department, you will join a multicultural, diverse team of skilled, enthusiastic telecommunication specialists from all over the world. As a telecom engineer with a strong network background, you will create, design and develop integrated critical communication systems for the offshore energy industry. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, or in Gdynia or Norfolk. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel from 10-30 days per year depending on which office you will be working at.

“This is an exciting chance to become part of an expanding energy industry, where you can benefit from outstanding career development opportunities. You’ll collaborate with highly skilled and dedicated professionals who are committed to excelling in their field. The role involves working on diverse projects of various scales worldwide, within a collaborative team environment where success is shared” says Head of Engineering, Technology Solutions, Kurt Thorøe.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As a Telecom & Network Engineer, you will design integrated telecom solutions with a strong focus on industrial network technologies. A hands-on, mid-level role turning benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, supporting transfer to manufacturing partners and delivering material for formulation, soil and field testing.

About Yngvi Bio

At Yngvi Bio, we are building a biological crop-protection platform based on targeted, non-living protein complexes. Our technology combines AI-guided protein design, insect genetics and microbial production. We are moving active prototypes from biological testing into scalable fermentation, formulation, soil and field validation.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on, mid-level Bioprocessing Specialist to turn benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, support transfer to manufacturing partners and deliver consistent material for formulation, soil and field testing. This individual-contributor role suits someone who has directly participated in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles and still enjoys working at the bench and bioreactor.

Key responsibilities

• Fermentation development. Plan and execute microbial batch and fed-batch fermentations, including media, feed, induction, pH, dissolved oxygen, aeration, temperature and harvest strategies.

• Protein expression and optimization. Improve recombinant protein expression, solubility, yield, product quality and robustness by linking process conditions to biological performance.

• Scale-up and technology transfer. Translate laboratory processes toward 50-1,000 L and beyond; define scale criteria, run plans, acceptance criteria and transfer packages, and support partner execution.

• Production execution. Run repeatable, traceable batches that supply characterized material for formulation, soil, greenhouse and field testing.

• Harvest and fit-for-purpose recovery. Personally perform and improve harvest, cell disruption or extraction, clarification, concentration and the minimal purification needed for testing.

• Troubleshooting, data and quality control. Use structured experiments, data analysis, in-process controls and practical quality checks to investigate deviations and connect upstream choices to recovery and lot quality.

• Documentation and collaboration. Maintain SOPs, batch records, risk assessments and transfer documentation, and work closely with scientists, formulation and agronomy colleagues, quality functions and external manufacturing partners.

You will be responsible for practical process development and execution while helping Yngvi Bio build the documentation and production discipline needed for reliable internal batches and partner transfer.

Qualifications

• Relevant experience. Typically 3-6 years in microbial fermentation, upstream bioprocess development or production-facing biotechnology.

• Hands-on fermentation. Strong practical experience setting up, running, sampling and troubleshooting microbial bioreactors.

• Recombinant protein expression. Practical experience with microbial expression is important; bacterial systems such as E. coli are preferred. You can connect process conditions to expression, solubility, quality and recovery.

• Scale-up evidence. Direct involvement in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles beyond small laboratory reactors, with the ability to explain what changed between scales.

• Production and downstream practice. Experience producing test or pilot material and personally performing harvest, extraction, clarification and basic purification or recovery.

• Education and working style. BSc, MSc, PhD or equivalent practical expertise in engineering, biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related field, combined with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach suited to an early-stage company.

• Valuable extras. Experience expressing virus-like particles, capsid-like structures, multimeric or self-assembling proteins, or other complex recombinant proteins is a bonus. Experience with design of experiments, automation, advanced downstream processing, CDMOs or agricultural biotechnology is also valuable.

What we offer

• A role with direct influence on how Yngvi Bio turns designed proteins into repeatable, scalable production.

• Work spanning fermentation, production, scale-up and the delivery of material for formulation, soil and field testing.

• A small international team at BioInnovation Institute where you can build practical systems, solve difficult technical challenges and grow with the role.

Role details

Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen. The role is laboratory-based and may involve occasional partner or manufacturing-site travel.

Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and a short application describing your hands-on fermentation, recombinant-protein production and scale-up experience to info@yngvi.bio.

Application reference: Begin the subject line or application title with Yngvi-BP26-[Surname] Application. For example: Yngvi-BP26-Nielsen Application.

**Application Process

**Apply by uploading your CV and grades **no later than November 23rd.

**We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

**About Devoteam

**Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams - Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

Do you want to build the operational backbone behind a new way of monetizing software - where pricing, product usage, data, and billing all need to connect seamlessly?

Trackunit is changing how we charge customers as we move from a traditional SaaS model towards more flexible, usage-based offerings. That means we need to connect a lot of moving parts: what customers use, how that usage is measured, what they have agreed to pay for, and what ultimately appears on their invoice.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Virtual meet and greet with the hiring manager and someone from the team.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

**The question is: Are you in?

**

Stillingsbeskrivelse

Do you want to immerse yourself in testing and quality assurance of large and complex software projects that help digitalise and strengthen Denmark? Are you systematic, with a keen eye for detail? Then you might be the person we are looking for as our new Test Consultant.

Responsibilities and technologies

Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

You will always be part of a project team from Netcompany, typically working together on-site with the client. In this role, you will act as the link between the client, their business needs, and our technical solution.

You will continuously develop your testing and technical skills. Throughout your projects, you will gain hands-on experience with a wide range of the latest technologies and tools.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Analysing the functional aspects of the solution

• Preparing test plans and designing and writing test cases

• Executing functional and non-functional tests

• Contributing to troubleshooting and test reporting

About you

You can work methodically and connect business and IT-related challenges, explaining business needs to developers and technical aspects to clients. In addition, we imagine that you:

• Can navigate complex error scenarios and understand complex system landscapes

• Are systematic and detail-oriented throughout the analysis, design, development, and testing phases

• Think logically and analytically, and can break down and understand complex concepts and communicate issues and gaps clearly and effectively

• Hold a relevant master’s degree

Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

jobs.occupation: Head of Translational Medicine and Early Development
jobs.description:
Turn scientific promise into clinical progress. Build the proof-of-concept engine that helps LEO Pharma make smarter development decisions and bring meaningful innovation closer to patients.

Shape What Comes Next

How would you connect emerging biology, quantitative insights, and clinical expertise to shape the next generation of development programs? At LEO Pharma, you will lead Translational Medicine & Early Development, bringing together people, partners, and evidence to answer critical questions early. This is an opportunity to build capabilities, influence portfolio decisions, and connect scientific ambition with a clear path to clinical proof of concept.

Your role

You will build and lead an integrated proof-of-concept engine, translating biological hypotheses into clinically testable, quantitatively informed, decision-ready programs. Working across internal teams and external partners, you will establish mechanism-based rationales, meaningful patient strategies, and robust development plans. Your focus will be on generating the evidence needed to select doses, assess benefit–risk, and guide progression toward registrational studies.

Your primary responsibilities will be to:

• Lead translational and early-development strategy across programs, developing people leaders and subject-matter experts.

• Partner with Science, Search & Innovation and clinical teams to design early-phase studies demonstrating target engagement, proof of mechanism, and patient relevance.

• Integrate biomarkers, patient stratification, quantitative pharmacology, and modelling and simulation to optimize doses, regimens, endpoints, and study designs.

• Support clinical due diligence and integration of externally sourced assets, building partnerships that strengthen translational capabilities.

• Shape regulatory and cross-functional evidence strategies, translating complex findings into clear recommendations for project teams and governance forums.

You will also establish progression criteria and performance indicators that strengthen decision quality, evidence maturity, execution, and resource efficiency. Throughout early development, you will ensure efficacy hypotheses are considered alongside safety, tolerability, and therapeutic index.

Your Qualifications

You bring scientific depth and leadership experience, with the ability to connect translational evidence to clinical and portfolio decisions.

We are looking for:

• An advanced degree in Medicine, Pharmacology, Translational Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline; MD and PhD qualifications are preferred.

• Significant leadership experience in translational medicine, clinical pharmacology, and/or early clinical development within biotech or pharma.

• Demonstrated expertise in early-phase studies in patients and healthy participants, linking mechanisms of action and biomarkers to dose selection and development strategy.

• A track record of building high-performing global teams, developing people, and integrating external assets and partnerships.

• Experience contributing to regulatory submissions and evidence generation supporting registration and market access.

Experience with externally sourced innovation is strongly preferred; dermatology and/or rare-disease experience is beneficial. You combine strategic thinking with curiosity, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach, influencing effectively across a matrix organization.

Your new team

You will lead Translational Medicine & Early Development, with two line managers as direct reports, the group is in total 20 employees. You will report to the Vice President, Head of Global Clinical Development.

Your network will span clinical development, skin science, regulatory, safety, market access, and commercial colleagues. Together with external collaborators, you will connect expertise across disciplines to strengthen early development.

Contact and application

For additional information, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Sabina Ravn Lebech at saleb@leo-pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

Report a concern: Whistleblower hotline | LEO Pharma
